help.title: Help
help.description: Keyboard and mouse controls for the organize preview sidebar.
help.organizeDescription: These shortcuts apply while an image or video preview tab is active in the organize inspector.

items.resizeInspector: Drag the divider between the browser and the sidebar to resize the preview column.
items.imagePrevious: Move to the previous image in the current organize selection.
items.imageNext: Move to the next image in the current organize selection.
items.imageZoom: Zoom the image preview. Scroll up zooms in, scroll down zooms out.
items.imageOpenWindow: Open the selected image in a detached global preview window.
items.videoPrevious: Move to the previous or next video in the current organize selection.
items.videoNext: Move to the previous or next video in the current organize selection.
items.videoSeek: Seek backward or forward by 5 seconds without pausing playback.
items.videoFrameStep: Step a single frame and pause playback. Scroll up moves backward, scroll down moves forward.
items.videoToggle: Toggle playback by pressing Space or clicking the video surface.
